note: A log of re-verifications of the current federal members and senators (scripts/roster_reverify.py). A record of what was checked and when; nothing on the site reads or displays it, and it changes no roster date. A real difference goes through scripts/roster_accept.json.

verifications.scope: Current federal members and senators: the shipped roster (portal/public/parliamentarians.json) and the federal seat roster in the electorate release (as at 2026-09-04)

senate_cross_check.source: scripts/handbook_party_service.json (Parliamentary Handbook, already in the repo)

verifications.result: Who sits, in which house and for which seat agrees with the source as it stood on 2026-09-11, with one open difference (the roster row for Chris Gatenby records no Senate seat). Nothing after 2026-09-11 is verified by this source; the Senate alone is cross-checked to 2026-11-13.
